name: sharded-counters-p4
prompt: how can I count a very hot metric without all the writers contending on one row

chunks.content: the unread notification badge now animates when the count changes
tuned autovacuum to run more aggressively on the high-churn sessions table
the editor shows a live word count and character count in the footer as you type
hard bounces are recorded and the address is suppressed from future sends
application logs rotate daily and keep 14 compressed archives
decided to split the hot like-counter across 64 shard rows chosen at random per increment, so concurrent writers update different rows and stop fighting over a single hot row
to read the total we sum across all 64 shards in one query and cache the result for a few seconds since an exact instantaneous value is not required
the warehouse job recounts physical stock nightly and flags any SKU whose counted quantity drifts from the recorded amount
we sized the shard count to roughly match peak concurrent writers, since too few shards still contend and too many slows the read-time fan-in sum
each shard increment is a single atomic update so we avoid a read-modify-write race and never lose a tick under load
type-ahead suggestions come from a prefix index refreshed hourly
added right-to-left layout support for Arabic
the experimental recommendations widget is flag-gated to ten percent of staff
invoices can be exported to PDF with the company letterhead
closed tickets are archived to cold storage after 90 days
